# ScrapeRouter

> ScrapeRouter is a unified API for web scraping. Send one request to `/api/v1/scrape/`, and the platform routes it to the best scraper/proxy setup while returning one normalized response format.

Core idea: one endpoint, multiple scraper backends, routing + fallback + cost tracking.

## Core
- [Product homepage](https://www.scraperouter.com/): Public landing page with product positioning and primary navigation.
- [Free scraping check](https://www.scraperouter.com/check/): Paste a URL to see which scraper route works, what gets blocked, and likely request cost.
- [Free tools](https://www.scraperouter.com/free-tools/): Directory of free ScrapeRouter utilities, starting with the URL feasibility check.
- [Introduction](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/): High-level product overview and routing model.
- [Quickstart](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/quickstart/): Smallest request examples and first successful scrape flow.

## API
- [Scrape endpoint](https://www.scraperouter.com/api/v1/scrape/): Primary synchronous endpoint for creating a scrape transaction.
- [API requests reference](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/api/requests/): Request/response schema, examples, and scraper/proxy routing fields.
- [Authentication](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/authentication/): API key auth header format and usage details.
- [Errors](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/errors/): Error object format and common error handling patterns.
- [OpenAPI schema (JSON)](https://www.scraperouter.com/api/schema.json): Machine-readable API schema for SDK/tooling integration.

## Scrapers
- [Scraper guide](https://www.scraperouter.com/docs/guides/scrapers/): How to select scrapers, JS vs non-JS tradeoffs, and request options.
- [Scraper catalog](https://www.scraperouter.com/scrapers/): Public list of active scraper runtimes and provider metadata.
